purpose: Dataset-metadata screening and catalogue-identity rules applied AFTER the frozen searches have executed. Kept separate from config/stage1_search_config.json because that file's checksum is embedded in every archived run summary: correcting a screening rule must never invalidate a pinned search response.
change_control: Versioned here and recorded in config/protocol_change_register.csv. Changing these terms changes reported search-flow counts, so a change requires a regenerated registry and a stated rationale.

biological_scope.rule: A catalogue row is excluded only when nothing in its title, measurement types, or taxonomic content indicates phytoplankton or a phytoplankton-derived measurement. Deliberately permissive: over-inclusion is corrected by Stage 2 record-level screening, whereas over-exclusion silently removes a candidate from the study.
biological_scope.note: Provider titles abbreviate. Matching only the full word 'phytoplankton' discarded the Dutch RWS ('_phyto') and German BSH ('Phyto_Zoo') national series while known-item recall still reported them found.

scope_guaranteed_sources.reason: queried server-side with the prespecified phytoplankton clades, so every returned row is in biological scope by construction
queried through the provider's own Phytoplankton datatype
queried with the frozen biological and measurement terms

the Plankton Lifeform Extraction Tool catalogue is entirely plankton monitoring, and its dataset names are provider codes ('OSPAR_LLUR-SH_2010-2020') rather than descriptions. A keyword screen on such a name has no discriminative validity: it excluded DS17, a named register candidate for the German coastal Phaeocystis gap, while retaining DS18 only because that provider happened to append '_phyto'. Zooplankton-only PLET rows are therefore carried to Stage 2 record-level screening rather than dropped on a name.

geographic_screen.rule: Record, never enforce, at dataset level. Only OBIS applied the frozen polygon server-side. Every other family returns catalogue metadata whose stated coverage cannot prove where the underlying records lie, so Stage 2 action 4 performs the record-level domain intersection.

identity.collection_doi_rule: A DOI that one source attaches to more than one distinct normalized title is a collection DOI and is excluded from identity grouping. PLET publishes eight separate Marine Scotland series under 10.17031/1637; treating it as a dataset identity merged four distinct observatories into one family.
identity.title_rule: Case is folded before non-alphanumeric characters are stripped.

declared_unlinked.relation: PLET Cefas SmartBuoy 2001-2019 to Cefas Data Hub holdings 19624 (2001-2017) and 21250 (2018-2019)
declared_unlinked.reason: One-to-many across time; the Cefas holdings API exposes no DOI. No dataset-level rule can express this without asserting a duplication that does not exist.
